given: the stock API after the tracking-code split
when: an API client fetches a stock record
then: the response no longer includes a combined inventory_code field; batch_number and serial_number are the tracking identifiers returned in its place

independence.rationale: AC1-AC3 assert the new fields are present and correctly valued; this AC asserts the old combined field is absent. A response could carry batch_number and serial_number while still echoing inventory_code, passing the prior ACs but failing this one, so the removal is independently observable and breakable. (Feature-level open question: whether inventory_code is kept for backward compatibility.)
